items.title: Azure IoT Operations: Empowering the Future of Connectivity and Automation / Blogs / Perficient
items.author: Suraj Singh
items.description:
The Internet of Things (IoT) is transforming industries worldwide by seamlessly connecting devices, systems, and individuals — enabling innovations that were once considered unattainable. From smart homes to industrial automation, IoT is driving efficiency, enhancing innovation, and enabling data-driven decision-making across various sectors.

Leading this technological evolution is Microsoft Azure, a robust cloud computing platform that has established itself as a central hub for IoT operations.

This blog explores the core components of Azure IoT, highlighting how it streamlines and enhances IoT workflows. It also covers the key features that position Azure as a preferred solution for organizations aiming to scale and manage their IoT infrastructure effectively.

For the full article, please follow the link below:

Azure IoT Operations: Empowering the Future of Connectivity and Automation / Blogs / Perficient

items.title: Ultimate Guide to Setting Up Jenkins Server with DevSecOps Tools on AWS EC2. / Blogs / Perficient
items.author: Suraj Singh
items.description:
In this blog post, I will walk you through the process of setting up a Jenkins server integrated with key tools required to build a comprehensive and secure DevSecOps pipeline. This guide is intended for readers who have a basic understanding of working within the AWS Management Console.

This document provides a step-by-step guide to configuring a Jenkins server, integrated with essential tools to support the implementation of a secure and scalable DevSecOps pipeline. It is intended for users with a basic familiarity with the AWS Management Console.

For detailed instructions and the complete blog post, please refer to the following link: Ultimate Guide to Setting Up Jenkins Server with DevSecOps Tools on AWS EC2. / Blogs / Perficient
